pairs.note: annotation corrected: GLM does NOT know DSH model ids — prior-resistant, large effect

pairs.boundary: B1 multi-item dilution: wc-01 requires two findings plus a structured report; a single-item probe under-predicts the task's remaining load
B2 paraphrase confound: the task ceilings in every variant because even official-full paraphrases the taught template; E is confounded, not a mechanism failure

verdict: negative-monotone direction supported descriptively: 6/8 pairs consistent, both counterexamples carry identified boundary conditions (B1 multi-item dilution, B2 exact-phrase paraphrase). The protocol's practical value is validated: low-G probes flag the tasks worth piloting (all four G=0 probes map to E>=0.67 tasks) and high-G probes flag ceiling risks.
boundary_conditions: B1: composite G (min over the task's items) is required for multi-item tasks; single-item probes under-predict E
B2: exact-template-phrase tasks can be paraphrased even when G=0; effect measurement then requires semantic graders
claim_level: E1-methodological calibration (descriptive direction support, no significance claim at n=8).
